created_by: Dylan L.R. Pollock with Atlas continuity support
description: Master Plan v120.2 preserves the v120.1 architecture and makes its reasoning explicit. It presents the prototype-to-polished Huey Brain path, fixture-first proof, hybrid transcription strategy, parallel Huey Body work, LabTech/HueyTech separation, Briefcase field role, HIMS foundation, PyHuey cockpit, Command Center sandbox, and funding-dependent Huey Farm as deliberate decisions with defined consequences and evidence-based review triggers.

current_session_evidence: Generated-artifact cleanup merged into main via PR #743.
Salvaged local work was protected and later merged via PR #745, reducing the broad WIP surface to eight changed files before merge.
Legacy root compatibility wrappers were removed via PR #746, leaving canonical implementations under src/huey/memory/PY and src/huey/media.
Media-tool consolidation merged through PR #747, centralizing audio analysis under huey.media while retaining huey.audio compatibility.
HIMS foundation merged through PR #748 with src/huey/messaging, HIMSMessage, HIMSEvent, HIMSStore, tests, and architecture documentation; it is not wired as a controlling runtime.
The 2017 iMac 5K was decommissioned; reusable RAM was moved into the ASUS FX505DT.
The custom i9-12900K system is the active prototype Huey Brain development platform and current primary operator workstation, not the polished Huey Brain V1.
The Lenovo Legion Go is Windows 11 LabTech for feature testing; the ASUS FX505DT is Debian Forky mobile LabTech.
Briefcase is HueyTech: an LTE-capable portable field terminal intended to maintain reachability/liveness checks and support document work.
PyHuey is active both as a standalone application and embedded connector, and is the primary external prototype cockpit.
Command Center repository inspection established its current role as a runnable, mock-first GUI experiment whose useful interface concepts can be evaluated independently of operational systems.

decision_framework.purpose: Make architectural reasoning understandable, testable, and durable without turning explanation into apology.
writing_standard: Explain how the choice advances the project rather than defending it against every alternative.
Name the practical consequence so implementation teams know what changes.
Define the evidence that supports the decision.
Define the condition that would justify review without implying that every settled choice remains provisional.

truth_layers.current_reality: What exists and is directly observed now.
truth_layers.active_direction: What the project is deliberately building or validating next.
truth_layers.accepted_architecture: A chosen structure that guides implementation until evidence justifies review.
truth_layers.target_state: A longer-term objective whose implementation depends on resources, maturity, or future validation.
truth_layers.historical_lineage: Earlier systems and decisions retained to explain how the current architecture emerged.

decision_framework.tone_rule: Use calm, direct, evidence-led language. Boundaries are expressed as design properties and operating rules, not as defensive disclaimers.

prototype_to_polished_huey_brain.decision: Develop and validate Huey Brain V1 architecture on the custom i9-12900K prototype, then reproduce the accepted proof on a polished Huey Brain V1 system.
reasoning: The prototype provides a real platform for learning before the final system is frozen.
A separate polished stage turns successful experiments into reproducible system capability.
The transfer step exposes assumptions that work only on a development machine and forces those assumptions into documentation.
This structure allows rapid iteration now while protecting the meaning of a finished V1 declaration.
prototype_to_polished_huey_brain.operational_consequence: Prototype results guide architecture; polished V1 status is earned through repeatable transfer and validation.
prototype_to_polished_huey_brain.evidence_standard: A preserved fixture set, documented dependencies, attributable run records, and comparable results across prototype and polished hardware.
prototype_to_polished_huey_brain.review_trigger: Review the two-stage model only if the final hardware becomes identical to the prototype in role, configuration, and lifecycle, or if transfer testing proves unnecessary through repeated evidence.

i9_dual_role.decision: Use the i9 prototype as both the current primary operator workstation and the active prototype Huey Brain development platform.
reasoning: The system is the strongest available development platform and is already positioned for direct observation and iteration.
Concentrating early work reduces synchronization overhead while the architecture is still being discovered.
Its Intel hybrid-core design provides a useful basis for testing workload placement across performance and efficiency cores.
The explicit dual role preserves the final Huey Brain boundary while supporting efficient prototype work.
i9_dual_role.operational_consequence: Development and operation share one prototype during this phase, with configuration and run metadata preserving the distinction between workstation activity and Huey proof activity.
i9_dual_role.evidence_standard: Recorded CPU topology, resource use, process placement, thermals, storage health, and proof-run configuration.
i9_dual_role.review_trigger: Separate the roles when operator workloads interfere with proof repeatability, when polished V1 hardware is ready, or when security and availability requirements demand isolation.

fixture_first_proof.decision: Use known MP3 fixtures as the canonical V1 input.
reasoning: A preserved input makes transcription and orchestration results comparable across runs.
Stable fixtures isolate software, model, device, and configuration changes from microphone and room variability.
Repeatable media preparation creates a reliable debugging boundary before live capture is introduced.
The fixture becomes a durable regression asset that can travel from prototype to polished V1.
fixture_first_proof.operational_consequence: V1 success is evaluated against controlled inputs and attributable artifacts; live audio becomes a later integration layer rather than an early source of uncertainty.
fixture_first_proof.evidence_standard: Immutable source files or hashes, preparation manifests, transcript metadata, response records, and structured run logs.
fixture_first_proof.review_trigger: Introduce live microphone work after the fixture path is consistently reproducible and the additional capture variables can be measured independently.

hybrid_local_transcription.decision: Benchmark local transcription on both the i9-12900K CPU and Radeon RX 5500 XT, then assign primary, fallback, and cross-check roles from measured results.
reasoning: The CPU offers broad software compatibility and predictable availability.
The GPU may provide useful acceleration if its driver and backend path proves reliable.
Testing both prevents architecture from being selected by assumption or peak specifications alone.
A fallback path improves resilience, while cross-checking helps identify device-specific transcription drift.
hybrid_local_transcription.operational_consequence: Every benchmark records device, engine, model, configuration, latency, resource use, and output quality before a preferred path is declared.
hybrid_local_transcription.evidence_standard: Repeated runs across the same fixture set with correctness, latency, memory, thermals, failure rate, and setup complexity compared.
hybrid_local_transcription.review_trigger: Re-evaluate when drivers, transcription backends, model requirements, or polished V1 hardware materially change.

api_backed_response_baseline.decision: Use an API-backed response bridge as the V1 quality baseline while preserving mock and local experimental modes.
reasoning: The API path provides a dependable response reference while local compute remains constrained.
Separating transcription proof from local-model procurement keeps the first loop achievable.
Mock mode supports deterministic CI and failure-path testing.
Local experiments remain available for future sovereignty work without weakening the current proof contract.
api_backed_response_baseline.operational_consequence: Provider, model, request metadata, response, timing, and errors are logged explicitly while credentials remain outside source and run artifacts.
api_backed_response_baseline.evidence_standard: Repeatable request/response records, explicit configuration, secret-safe logs, and clear mock/API/local mode labels.
api_backed_response_baseline.review_trigger: Promote a local response model when available hardware and model quality meet the same reliability and traceability standard.

body_parallel_track.decision: Advance Huey Body construction and bounded actuation tests in parallel with the cognitive proof.
reasoning: Physical progress can continue without waiting for every cognitive layer to mature.
A parallel track preserves momentum while keeping failures attributable to either cognition or embodiment.
Bounded experiments create real mechanical and control evidence without making the fixture proof dependent on changing hardware.
The tracks can converge through explicit integration gates once both sides have stable interfaces.
body_parallel_track.operational_consequence: Body tests use defined scope, operator initiation, a safe stop path, and independent records; cognitive V1 completion remains based on the fixture-to-log contract.
body_parallel_track.evidence_standard: Documented test intent, hardware state, command boundary, observed result, failure behavior, and recovery path.
body_parallel_track.review_trigger: Promote Body integration into formal completion criteria only after Brain and Body interfaces are stable and repeated integration tests show that the combined requirement improves the proof.

labtech_hueytech_separation.decision: Classify external development systems as LabTech and explicitly activated Huey-side systems as HueyTech.
reasoning: The distinction keeps development convenience separate from system identity and authority.
A device can support Huey extensively without becoming part of Huey itself.
Explicit classification makes ingress, recovery, logging, and control boundaries easier to audit.
The model preserves hardware flexibility because roles can change through deliberate promotion rather than implication.
labtech_hueytech_separation.operational_consequence: ASUS FX505DT and Lenovo Legion Go remain LabTech; the prototype, polished Brain, Body, Briefcase, HueyOS, media, and HIMS components carry explicit Huey-side classifications and statuses.
labtech_hueytech_separation.evidence_standard: A documented role, authority boundary, operating status, and promotion decision for each device or service.
labtech_hueytech_separation.review_trigger: Reclassify a system when its enduring role, authority, and lifecycle move across the external/Huey boundary.

briefcase_field_role.decision: Use Briefcase as portable LTE-connected HueyTech for reachability, communication, documents, field work, and recovery access.
reasoning: LTE provides a path to check Huey beyond the local network.
The 2-in-1 form supports documentation and practical field operation in one device.
A dedicated field role gives remote access a clear home instead of distributing it across ad hoc devices.
Beginning with status and recovery functions establishes value before broader authority is considered.
briefcase_field_role.operational_consequence: Briefcase development prioritizes dependable reachability, authenticated communication, documentation, and recovery workflows.
briefcase_field_role.evidence_standard: Successful remote health checks, documented authentication, connection-loss behavior, audit records, and recovery exercises.
briefcase_field_role.review_trigger: Expand authority only after authentication, audit, failure handling, and revocation are proven under field conditions.

hims_foundation_before_authority.decision: Build HIMS first as merged append-only messaging infrastructure and introduce routing authority in explicit later stages.
reasoning: Immutable envelopes and append-only events create an attributable communication record.
Infrastructure can be tested before it is trusted with control decisions.
Separating message existence from execution authority prevents accidental coupling.
Optional shadow traces let the project rehearse future routing around a working proof loop.
hims_foundation_before_authority.operational_consequence: The structured V1 log remains canonical; HIMS may mirror events without becoming a required dependency or action gate.
hims_foundation_before_authority.evidence_standard: Schema validation, append-only behavior, replayable events, stable correlation IDs, and optional trace operation that leaves V1 success unchanged.
hims_foundation_before_authority.review_trigger: Advance HIMS authority only after routing policy, validation roles, execution gates, refusal behavior, and recovery have independent tests.

pyhuey_primary_cockpit.decision: Use PyHuey as the primary external operator cockpit in both standalone and embedded-connector forms.
reasoning: The PyGPT/PyGPT-net foundation is stable and already provides a mature interaction surface.
Reusing a working cockpit concentrates project effort on Huey-specific integration rather than rebuilding general interface machinery.
Standalone and embedded forms support both independent operation and bounded integration.
Keeping the cockpit external preserves a clear distinction between interface, messaging, governance, and cognition.
pyhuey_primary_cockpit.operational_consequence: PyHuey receives bounded tools, status, logs, and provider workflows through explicit adapters while the proof remains runnable without the GUI.
pyhuey_primary_cockpit.evidence_standard: Stable launches, defined tool manifests, attributable actions, safe failure behavior, and successful CLI fallback.
pyhuey_primary_cockpit.review_trigger: Review cockpit architecture when PyHuey limits essential workflows, its upstream foundation becomes unsuitable, or a more maintainable project-aligned interface proves superior.

command_center_sandbox.decision: Retain Command Center as an experimental GUI companion and interface-design sandbox.
reasoning: The repository contains useful visual patterns, local persistence concepts, and prototype operator views.
Its mock-first implementation makes it suitable for exploring presentation without placing operational systems at risk.
Keeping it experimental allows valuable ideas to be salvaged selectively.
Operational promotion requires deliberate product identity, integration, testing, and credential architecture rather than incremental assumption.
command_center_sandbox.operational_consequence: Command Center remains isolated from credentials and Huey control; useful components may be reviewed and migrated into supported surfaces.
command_center_sandbox.evidence_standard: Accurate package identity, current documentation, tested data adapters, secure credential handling, correct repository metrics, and a maintained test suite.
command_center_sandbox.review_trigger: Consider promotion after the repository meets the evidence standard and demonstrates a unique role not already served by PyHuey.

huey_farm_funding_gate.decision: Keep Huey Farm as a funding-dependent target with approximately 80 GB pooled local VRAM as a testing goal and gpt-oss-120b as a provisional candidate.
reasoning: Large open-weight model experiments require substantially more memory and power than current V1 proof work.
A funding gate keeps immediate architecture focused on obtainable hardware and current proof needs.
The 80 GB target provides a concrete planning scale without freezing a final card layout.
Provisional model selection preserves flexibility as open-weight models and hardware economics change.
huey_farm_funding_gate.operational_consequence: Farm procurement waits for funding and a fresh model/hardware comparison; V1 remains independent of Farm capacity.
huey_farm_funding_gate.evidence_standard: Current model requirements, benchmark relevance, total acquisition cost, power and cooling feasibility, software support, and upgrade path.
huey_farm_funding_gate.review_trigger: Re-specify the Farm when funding becomes realistic or a model/hardware combination materially changes the best attainable architecture.

documentation_layering.decision: Keep the README, master plan, technical docs, governance documents, website, and archives as distinct documentation layers.
reasoning: Each audience needs a different level of detail and authority.
Layering prevents operational facts, public explanation, legal doctrine, and historical continuity from being mistaken for one another.
The master plan can preserve detailed reasoning while the README remains understandable.
Separate layers allow one surface to evolve without silently rewriting the purpose of another.
documentation_layering.operational_consequence: The master plan holds machine-facing decisions and full rationale; the README provides orientation and concise reasoning; implementation details live in runbooks and audits; governance changes require their own process.
documentation_layering.evidence_standard: Consistent terminology, explicit cross-references, current version labels, and documented conflict resolution.
documentation_layering.review_trigger: Adjust the layer boundaries when readers consistently cannot find the right detail or when duplication creates measurable canon drift.

current_reality.summary: The project is developing the fixture-to-log proof on a custom i9-12900K prototype Huey Brain platform and will reproduce the accepted architecture on polished Huey Brain V1. Huey Brain V1 and Huey Body are under active development with operational validation pending. LabTech supports development and feature testing. Briefcase provides portable HueyTech capability. HIMS supplies merged append-only infrastructure at the foundation stage. Huey Body advances through a bounded parallel track, and Huey Farm proceeds when funding supports a fresh hardware and model decision.

current_reality.current_phase: Prototype Huey Brain development, fixture-to-log proof validation, polished Huey Brain V1 build, and parallel Huey Body work
active_truths: The custom i9-12900K system is the active prototype/development platform and current primary operator workstation; it informs but is not identical to the polished Huey Brain V1.

Huey Body actuation advances through a bounded parallel track while cognitive-proof completion remains defined by the fixture-to-log contract.
LabTech develops, tests, documents, observes, archives, and recovers; HueyTech carries explicitly activated Huey-side capability.

Temporary-use devices and external tools remain assistive surfaces governed by explicit project boundaries.

PyHuey is the primary external prototype cockpit in both standalone and embedded-connector forms; the canonical proof retains a CLI-capable path.

Constitutional multi-agent governance remains target-state architecture pending a validated runtime foundation.
Huey Farm capacity remains a later funded expansion and is outside V1 completion.

v1_5_augmented_proof.scope_statement: V1.5 adds optional HIMS shadow messages, PyHuey tool manifests, and media preview artifacts. Bounded Body work continues on its parallel track, and cognitive-proof completion remains defined by the fixture-to-log contract.

v1_5_augmented_proof.completion_signal: A fixture batch produces normal V1 logs plus coherent HIMS shadow traces and dashboard/tool-manifest visibility, with no additional runtime authority granted to HIMS or GUI layers.

PyHuey exposes fixed, reviewed tools with attributable results.
Command Center remains isolated from credentials and Huey control until a separately reviewed promotion satisfies its evidence standard.

hims.name: Huey Internal Messaging System

current_implementation_posture.important_boundary: The HIMS package can exist before HIMS becomes a controlling runtime. V1 remains simple pipeline plus structured log.

hims.core_idea: HIMS is the internal message, route, validation, and record layer that lets Huey subsystems communicate without direct memory sharing or hidden authority collapse.
why_it_exists: To make requests, proposals, reports, alerts, refusals, and execution records visible and replayable.
To separate sender, router, validator, executor, and logger roles.
To prevent GUI, portal, LabTech, or agent layers from becoming hidden authorities.
To provide future lawful routing from input to decision to action without bypassing review.

thundermail_relation.ThunderMail: mail-style delivery semantics inside HIMS: inboxes, outboxes, acknowledgements, routing, and queues
thundermail_relation.HIMS: larger trust, validation, routing, compartmentalization, and preserved-record doctrine
thundermail_relation.rule: ThunderMail is delivery behavior; HIMS is the governing internal message system.

HIMSEvent.rule: State changes are separate append-only events.

HIMSStore.role: local JSONL store with send, inbox, outbox, channel, mark_delivered, mark_read, archive, events_for, status_for
HIMSStore.rule: Previous records remain immutable; lifecycle changes are appended as new events.

trust_classes_v120_2.2_operator_visible: Messages intended for bounded operator/PyHuey visibility.
trust_classes_v120_2.3_private_or_role_restricted: Bounded agent, role, or office traffic not globally visible.
trust_classes_v120_2.4_official_record: Messages that become official project/runtime state records.
trust_classes_v120_2.5_safety_critical: Thermal, power, storage, motion, recovery, or preservation traffic.

v1_boundary: HIMS may operate as a foundation library while V1 remains independently executable.
The V1 structured run log remains the canonical proof artifact.
Citizen mailboxes, governance votes, and action authority advance through later declared phases.
V1.5 may mirror stage traces to HIMS as shadow messages.
safety_rules: Message existence and execution authority remain separate properties.
Routers preserve authorship rather than inheriting it.
Validators assess requests while executors retain separately granted responsibility.
GUI- and LabTech-originated messages use bounded, attributable channels.
Physical action requires an explicitly authorized, bounded, and auditable execution path.
